_note: FICTIONAL demo script for offline/demo mode. No real people or calls. The scripted client explicitly consents to transcription, mirroring the consent gate the real bot enforces.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Guten Tag, Dr. Weber — thank you for taking the time today. Before we start: with your permission I'll have our assistant transcribe this call so we both get accurate notes. Is that OK?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Yes, that is fine. Please go ahead.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Thank you. I sent you the agenda — five topics: your current process, SAP integration, security and hosting, pricing, and next steps.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: We run our entire operation on SAP S/4HANA — customs declarations, shipment tracking, invoicing. Does your platform integrate with it?

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Good question — I am checking that live right now. And on security: I will send you our security document and the data processing agreement this week.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: We will need to review GDPR compliance and where the data is hosted in detail. Do you host in the EU?

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Yes — Paris region, EU-only residency, SOC 2 Type II. The security document covers all of that.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Our current process is very manual. Customs paperwork is checked by hand by four people, and errors cost us real money — last quarter we had two misfiled declarations.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: That is exactly the kind of pain we automate. Who else is involved in the decision on your side?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: I will need to align with our works council, and our CFO signs off on anything above fifty thousand euros.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Roughly speaking, we are about 300 users across three sites, and our budget for this is around 90,000 euros per year.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: On pricing: list price aside, we would need at least 25% discount to make this work.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: I understand. Let me be direct with you: our floor for 300 seats is 12%, and I can offer that if we sign a two-year contract today.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: A two-year contract is not possible for us right now — budget is approved annually. What can you do at 15%?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: One more thing — how long would implementation take? We need this running before Q3.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Typical onboarding is four to six weeks including the SAP connector. I can put that in writing as a pilot plan with milestones.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: That sounds reasonable. Send me the pilot plan, the security document, and a written proposal with the 12% two-year option. We will decide internally within two weeks.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Perfect — I'll send all three today, and I'll follow up next week if I don't hear back. Thank you, Dr. Weber.
